description: Bond spoken-word golden vector for @forgesworn/kenspeckle ./bond. Uses the frozen ECDH secret and pubkeys from bond.ecdh.v1.json. For each row, bondWords(secret, pubA, pubB, counter, { namespace }) MUST return { mine: aMine, theirs: aTheirs }, and the B seat (pubB, pubA) MUST return the mirror { mine: aTheirs, theirs: aMine }. Frozen against spoken-token internals (pair\0 context, wordlist): a dependency bump that changes any word changes every contact's words and must fail here. The signet:me rows were independently confirmed against signet-protocol's OWN implementation: `getSignetMeDisplay(secret, pubA, pubB, 1, nowMs)` in the sibling `signet` repo (npm package `signet-protocol`, src/signet-me.ts, built dist/signet-me.js, spoken-token@2.1.0 — the same version installed here), called with `nowMs = counter * SIGNET_ME_ROTATION_SECONDS * 1000` to land on each target counter (its rotation period is 30s, vs. this repo's raw counter argument). Its output matched these aMine/aTheirs values byte-for-byte at every counter in this vector, so the signet:me rows are cross-implementation-verified, not merely kenspeckle's own output re-recorded.
